environment.description: Same Lambda function in VPC (subnet-0e5f6a7b) with Step Functions state machine 'DataPipelineOrchestrator-prod'. S3 access is routed through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0x9y8z7w6v) with an endpoint policy that includes a condition restricting requests: the policy allows s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject ONLY when aws:Referer header matches the internal tracking token AND the s3:prefix condition key starts with 'configs/' or 'baselines/' for the specific bucket. Additionally, the VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached — all outbound traffic is restricted to VPC endpoints only (S3 gateway endpoint, DynamoDB endpoint, and STS interface endpoint). Security group on Lambda ENI allows egress only to the S3 prefix list (pl-63a5400a) and the internal ALB CIDR (10.0.0.0/16). DNS resolution for external domains fails as there is no Route53 resolver outbound endpoint configured for non-internal zones.
